_comment: Catalyst vs Pterodactyl benchmark suites. Each suite has catalyst + pterodactyl specs. Runner picks appropriate base+auth per target.

suites.label: List servers
suites.description: GET server list — primary pagination path. Catalyst: /api/servers filtered by user access. Ptero: Application API paginated list.

suites.label: Get single server
suites.description: GET one server by id. Requires PAPER_SERVER_ID / PTERO_SERVER_ID from state.env.

suites.label: Server activity log
suites.description: GET paginated audit/activity for a server.

suites.label: Stats history (1h)
suites.description: Time-series metrics read — DB + retention query.

suites.label: File list (root)
suites.description: File explorer root listing — tunnels through agent (includes node-online check). Ptero: Wings file list via panel proxy.

ops.label: File write (1KB) + readback
ops.description: POST /files/write small file then GET download via file tunnel. Measures agent round-trip.

ops.label: File upload (256KB multipart)
ops.description: Multipart upload via /files/upload — includes Fastify multipart + agent streaming.

ops.label: Server create burst (10 creates)
ops.description: Create 10 stopped servers sequentially vs Wings — measures API + DB + allocation.

ops.label: Lifecycle: start→running
ops.description: Start a stopped server and time to 'running' (containerd vs Docker). Requires a stopped bench server.

ops.label: SSE connect (first event ms)
ops.description: Time to first byte on /api/servers/:id/events SSE stream. 20 parallel connects.

ops.label: WS console echo (agent round-trip)
ops.description: Send console command via WS/SSE and measure echo. Requires running server.

ops.label: Backup create (tiny server)
ops.description: Create a backup of a tiny fixture server. Measures snapshot + storage path.

ops.label: Migration import (50 servers)
ops.description: Full Pterodactyl import of the 50-server bulk fixture via /api/admin/migration. End-to-end wall time.

ops.label: SFTP throughput (1MB)
ops.description: SFTP put/get 1MB file via ssh2. Requires SFTP token + running node.
